maximum_depth_rule: All 304 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements are retained exactly once with their registered PDF, source location, raw text, tokens, unit, scope, operator, and unresolved comparability boundary.
version_boundary: The March 2022 revised long-term vision and the elderly, gender equality, domestic-violence prevention, industry, health, education, environment, and other source plans remain separate versions and layers.
non_goals: Do not infer additional records from unregistered vision or individual-plan documents.
Do not merge same-named indicators when source plan, period, unit, or population differs.
Do not replace the overall vision assessment with evaluation from an individual plan.
Do not calculate policy achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
